description: CWTS Leiden Ranking Open Edition 2025 (publication-based, about 2,800 universities, OpenAlex data): for a country or continent, field and period (2006-2009 to 2020-2023), each university's rank, name, country and the indicators of the chosen dimension: scientific impact (P, top 1%), collaboration (international, industry) or open access (P(OA), PP(OA)). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

continent.description: Instead of country: AF, AS, EU, NA, OC or SA

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. TR, DE, US (omit for world)

field.description: all (default), biomedical, life, math, physical or social

indicator.description: Indicator set within the dimension, 1 to 5 (default 1; collaboration: 1 all, 2 international, 3 industry, 4 <100 km, 5 >5000 km)

period.description: Last year of the 4-year window, 2009 to 2023 (default 2023 = 2020-2023)

name: search_leiden_ranking
title: Search Leiden Ranking
